concepts.learning_objective: Explain how lactic acid bacteria convert milk into curd and improve its nutritional value.
Describe the role of microbes in fermenting dough and traditional foods and drinks.
Relate the texture and flavour of different cheeses to the specific microbes used.
Describe the use of brewer's yeast in producing distilled and undistilled alcoholic beverages.
Explain what antibiotics are and outline the discovery and development of penicillin.

topics.title: Chemicals, enzymes and other bioactive molecules

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the microbes used for commercial production of organic acids and ethanol.
State the uses of microbial enzymes such as lipases, pectinases, proteases and streptokinase.
Describe the sources and uses of cyclosporin A and statins.
Describe the physical steps of primary sewage treatment.
Explain biological secondary treatment and interpret BOD as a measure of organic pollution.
Explain the fate of activated sludge and the role of anaerobic sludge digesters.
Explain the role of methanogens in producing methane from cellulosic material.
Describe the structure and working of a gobar gas plant.
Explain the principle of biological pest control in organic farming.
Explain how Bacillus thuringiensis is used to control caterpillars.
Describe Trichoderma and baculoviruses as specific biocontrol agents.
Distinguish between symbiotic and free-living nitrogen-fixing bacteria used as biofertilisers.
Explain the benefits of mycorrhizal associations to plants.
Describe the role of cyanobacteria as biofertilisers in paddy fields.
